metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel / Log Analytics workspace name.

properties.displayName: FortiNDR Cloud - High Severity Event Detected
properties.description: Triggers an alert for any high or critical severity event across FortiNDR Cloud detections, Suricata alerts, or observations.
properties.query:
Fortinet_FortiNDR_Cloud
| where (Type == 'FncEventsDetections_CL' and de_severity in~ ('high', 'critical'))
     or (Type == 'FncEventsSuricata_CL' and su_sig_severity <= 2)
     or (Type == 'FncEventsObservation_CL' and ob_confidence in~ ('high', 'critical'))
| extend IncidentDevice = coalesce(de_device_ip, su_src_ip, ob_src_ip)
| extend Description = coalesce(de_rule_name, su_sig_name, ob_observation_title)
